collection.description: An omen predicts a disaster, but nothing happens.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: An omen predicts a disaster, but nothing happens.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A villager believes their own actions may have changed fate.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A neighbor says omens are often readings of weather and wildlife.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A devotee suggests an omen can be a warning rather than a promise.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: A skeptic asks how many predictions failed and went unremembered.

r1.name: Resolution 1
r1.text: The villager discovers a plausible ordinary cause but may still value the experience for personal reasons.

text_only.reason: a memory of what happened, not a skill's experience: nothing is gained

r2.name: Resolution 2
r2.text: A second witness or unexpected detail complicates the simplest explanation.

r3.name: Resolution 3
r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
